regions.name: Manaslu Circuit Adventures
regions.description:
The Manaslu Trekking Region is one of Nepal’s premier off-the-beaten-path Himalayan destinations, encircling Mount Manaslu (8,163 m / 26,781 ft) — the eighth highest mountain in the world. Named after the Sanskrit word 'Manasa', meaning "Mountain of the Spirit", Manaslu offers a perfect blend of high-altitude adventure, dramatic glacial landscapes, and deeply preserved Tibetan-Buddhist cultural heritage.

Designated as a restricted trekking area in 1991 to protect its pristine wilderness and fragile ecosystems, the Manaslu Circuit requires special restricted permits and mandatory licensed guide support. This controlled tourism keeps the trails uncrowded and quiet compared to neighboring classic routes, allowing trekkers to experience the authentic raw beauty of the remote Himalayas.

The ultimate highlight of trekking in the Manaslu region is crossing the formidable Larke La Pass (5,106 m / 16,752 ft). This dramatic mountain pass connects the Gorkha and Manang districts, rewarding adventurers with 360-degree panoramas of Mount Manaslu, Himlung Himal (7,126 m), Cheo Himal, Kang Guru, and Annapurna II. The route descends into high-alpine glacial basins, passing icefalls, turquoise lakes, and ancient lateral moraines.

tourTrips.title: Everest Base Camp Trek – 15 Days
tourTrips.destination: Everest Base Camp, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: An unforgettable 15-day Himalayan adventure to Everest Base Camp (5,360 m) and Kala Patthar (5,545 m) through the heart of the Khumbu region.
tourTrips.description:
The 15-Day Everest Base Camp Trek is an unforgettable Himalayan adventure that takes you through the heart of the Khumbu region to the base of Mount Everest (8,848 m).

Experience spectacular mountain scenery, Sherpa culture, Buddhist monasteries, traditional villages, and the legendary Everest Base Camp. The trek also includes an early-morning hike to Kala Patthar (5,545 m) for breathtaking panoramic views of Everest and the surrounding peaks.

Why Everest Base Camp?

Everest Base Camp is more than a trek—it is an opportunity to experience the Himalayas up close. The trail passes through colorful Sherpa villages, suspension bridges, alpine forests, monasteries and dramatic mountain landscapes.

From Namche Bazaar to Tengboche, Dingboche and Gorakshep, every stage offers a different Himalayan experience. The journey reaches its highlight at Everest Base Camp, followed by the spectacular sunrise hike to Kala Patthar.

Who Can Join?

The Everest Base Camp Trek is suitable for fit beginners as well as experienced trekkers. Previous high-altitude trekking experience is not essential, but regular walking and good physical preparation are recommended.

The itinerary can also be customized according to your fitness level, available time and travel preferences.

Lukla Flight Information

During busy trekking seasons, flights to Lukla may operate from Ramechhap Airport due to air traffic conditions. During other periods, flights may operate directly from Kathmandu.

Flight schedules are subject to weather and operational conditions.

Customize Your Everest Adventure

Looking for a different pace or level of comfort? We can customize the Everest Base Camp Trek according to your requirements, including duration, accommodation, private groups and additional sightseeing in Nepal.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Welcome to Nepal! Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, you will be greeted by our representative and transferred to your hotel in Kathmandu. After check-in, you can rest and recover from your journey. In the evening, there may be a short briefing about the trek and an opportunity to explore the nearby area.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Lukla – Phakding
itinerary.details:
Early in the morning, take a scenic flight toward Lukla, the gateway to the Everest region. The short flight offers spectacular views of the Himalayan landscape.

After landing at Lukla, meet the trekking team and begin walking through small mountain settlements, forests, and along the Dudh Koshi River. After several hours of trekking, arrive at Phakding.

itinerary.title: Phakding – Namche Bazaar
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, continue your trek through pine and rhododendron forests following the Dudh Koshi River. Cross several suspension bridges and pass through traditional Sherpa villages.

As you approach Namche, the trail becomes steeper. After entering Sagarmatha National Park and completing the final uphill section, you reach Namche Bazaar, the main trading and cultural center of the Khumbu region.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day in Namche
itinerary.details:
Today is an important rest and acclimatization day. Rather than staying completely inactive, take a short hike around Namche to help your body adjust to the increasing altitude.

You can hike toward the Everest View Hotel for impressive mountain scenery and views of Everest, Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and other Himalayan peaks. Later, explore Namche Bazaar, its shops, cafes, and local surroundings.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar – Tengboche
itinerary.details:
Leave Namche and follow a scenic trail overlooking the Himalayan valleys. The route offers beautiful views of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Ama Dablam.

The trail gradually descends before crossing the Dudh Koshi River and climbing through beautiful forests toward Tengboche. Tengboche is famous for its historic Buddhist monastery and spectacular mountain surroundings.

itinerary.title: Tengboche – Dingboche
itinerary.details:
Start the morning with beautiful views around Tengboche before descending through rhododendron and pine forests.

Continue toward Pangboche and follow the Imja Khola valley. As you move higher, the landscape becomes more open and alpine. Eventually, arrive at Dingboche, a traditional Sherpa settlement surrounded by impressive Himalayan peaks.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day in Dingboche
itinerary.details:
Another acclimatization day is scheduled before heading toward higher elevations. You can take a gradual hike toward Nangkartshang Peak or explore the surrounding hills and valleys.

The hike provides excellent views of Ama Dablam, Island Peak, Makalu, and other surrounding mountains. Spend the afternoon relaxing and preparing for the higher-altitude trekking days ahead.

itinerary.title: Dingboche – Lobuche
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, begin your journey toward Lobuche. The trail climbs gradually through the dry and rugged Himalayan landscape.

You will pass memorials dedicated to climbers and mountaineers who lost their lives in the Everest region. As you continue through the Khumbu valley, the surrounding mountains become increasingly dramatic.

Arrive at Lobuche and rest for the evening.

itinerary.title: Lobuche – Gorak Shep – Everest Base Camp – Gorak Shep
itinerary.details:
Today is one of the most important days of the trek. Begin early and walk toward Gorak Shep through the rugged Khumbu landscape.

After a short break, continue toward Everest Base Camp. The trail passes through glacial terrain and offers unforgettable views of the surrounding peaks and Khumbu Glacier.

Reach Everest Base Camp at approximately 5,360 meters, where you can enjoy the incredible atmosphere of the world's highest mountain region. After spending time at Base Camp, return to Gorak Shep for the night.

itinerary.title: Gorak Shep – Kala Patthar – Dingboche
itinerary.details:
Wake up early for the hike to Kala Patthar, one of the best viewpoints in the Everest region.

From the summit, enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Mount Everest, Nuptse, Pumori, Ama Dablam, and the surrounding Himalayan range. After taking in the scenery, descend toward Gorak Shep and continue down the trail to Dingboche.

itinerary.title: Dingboche – Namche Bazaar
itinerary.details:
Begin the return journey through the beautiful Khumbu Valley. The trail gradually descends through familiar villages and mountain landscapes.

Pass through Pangboche and Tengboche before continuing toward the lower elevations. After several hours of trekking, arrive back in Namche Bazaar, where you can enjoy a comfortable evening.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar – Lukla
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, begin the final major trekking day. Follow the trail downhill toward Phakding and continue along the Dudh Koshi River.

Cross suspension bridges and pass through the villages and forests of the Khumbu region before reaching Lukla. Celebrate the completion of your trek with your trekking team.

itinerary.title: Lukla – Kathmandu
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, take your return flight from Lukla to Kathmandu, subject to weather and flight operations.

Upon arrival in Kathmandu, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can relax, explore the city, shop for souvenirs, or simply recover after the trek.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Free Day
itinerary.details:
Enjoy a relaxed day in Kathmandu after completing your Everest adventure.

You can explore local attractions, visit cultural and historical sites, shop for souvenirs, or simply enjoy the city's restaurants and cafes. This day also provides some flexibility in case of earlier flight or weather-related changes during the trek.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.details:
Your Everest Base Camp adventure comes to an end today. Depending on your flight schedule, you will be transferred to Tribhuvan International Airport for your onward journey.

Take home unforgettable memories of the Himalayas, Sherpa culture, mountain villages, and your journey to the base of Mount Everest.

tourTrips.title: Everest Base Camp Trek with Gokyo - Chola Pass - 17 Days
tourTrips.destination: Gokyo & Everest Base Camp, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Comprehensive high-altitude circuit combining turquoise Gokyo Lakes, Gokyo Ri (5,360 m), challenging Cho La Pass (5,330 m), Everest Base Camp (5,360 m), and Kala Patthar (5,545 m).
tourTrips.description:
Everest Base Camp trek with Gokyo - Chola Pass is one of the most adventurous and popular journeys in the Himalayas of Nepal, loved by trekkers since the 1950s. EBC from Gokyo with Chola Pass is a must-do trek in Nepal where you explore the majestic Himalayas of the Khumbu Region along with high passes: Chola Pass (5,330 m), Gokyo Ri (5,360 m), and Kala Patthar (5,545 m). During this trek, travelers not only get to explore giant mountains but also experience authentic Sherpa culture.

Gokyo Chola Pass with EBC trekking is an extended version of the classic Everest Base Camp Trek, taking you to explore the highest altitude turquoise lakes at Gokyo (4,790 m) and cross the thrilling Chola Pass (5,330 m). Trekking through this route in Everest is truly a once-in-a-lifetime journey into the heart of the Himalayas.

Get Up Close to Mount Everest Like Never Before with Gokyo Lakes & Chola Pass

During this Everest – Gokyo Trekking, you get the chance to explore beautiful Sherpa villages and magnificent scenic views of the high Everest Himalayan range. This trek takes you to Gokyo (4,790 m), Gokyo Ri (5,360 m) with challenging Chola Pass (5,330 m), and then leads directly to Everest Base Camp (5,360 m).

This trek can be done clockwise (from Namche Bazaar to Gokyo side, crossing Chola Pass, and finally Everest Base Camp) or anti-clockwise. Our itinerary follows the clockwise route, which provides superior gradual acclimatization for high altitudes.

The trek begins with a scenic flight to Lukla's Tenzing-Hillary Airport, heading to Namche Bazaar, passing Dole and Machhermo before arriving at the stunning Gokyo Lakes. A hike up Gokyo Ri offers breathtaking views of Everest, Cho Oyu, Makalu, and Lhotse. After crossing the steep Chola Pass, trekkers hike up Kala Patthar and visit Everest Base Camp before descending past Tengboche Monastery.

Lukla Flight Information

Flight from Ramechhap (March, April, May, October & November): During peak seasons, due to heavy air traffic at Kathmandu airport, flights to Lukla operate from Ramechhap Airport. We take an early morning 4-hour drive from Kathmandu to Ramechhap, followed by a 20-minute flight to Lukla.

Flight from Kathmandu (December – February & June – September): During off-peak months, flights operate directly from Kathmandu to Lukla (35 minutes).

Everything You Need to Know About Chola Pass (5,330 m)

Chola Pass is the high-altitude bridge between Gokyo Valley and Everest Base Camp. Widely known as a summit pass, ascending Chola Pass feels like climbing a high rock mountain. With cold temperatures and rocky paths, it is a thrilling challenge. From the top of Chola Pass, enjoy panoramic views of Mount Ama Dablam, Cholatse, Mount Pumori, and Lobuche before descending into the Khumbu valley toward Everest Base Camp.

Who Can Do This Trek?

This trek is suitable for beginners with good fitness and determination, experienced trekkers looking for a Himalayan high-pass challenge, as well as solo travelers, couples, and group adventurers. No prior mountaineering experience is required—just good physical stamina and the right guidance!

Alternative Everest Treks

If you are looking for alternative options in the Everest region, we also offer:

  • Everest Renjo La Pass to Gokyo Trek – 13 Days
  • Everest Base Camp Trek – 15 Days
  • Everest Three Passes Trek – 19 Days
  • Everest Trek from Jiri – Gokyo – 22 Days

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details:
Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be warmly greeted by our correspondent holding a greeting sign with your name. After assisting with your luggage, you will be transferred via private vehicle to your hotel situated in the vibrant tourist district of Thamel or city center.

Once checked in, we will arrange a pre-trip meeting where we will brief in short about the trek, review your equipment, answer any queries you have, and introduce your trekking guide. Afterwards, you can relax and spend the rest of the day exploring at your leisure. Stay overnight at the hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Lukla (2840 m) – Phakding (2610 m)
itinerary.details:
Early in the morning, our guide will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to the domestic terminal of TIA. Take a scenic and thrilling 35-minute mountain flight to Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla (2,840 m), enjoying spectacular aerial views of the snow-capped Himalayan ranges.

After landing in Lukla, rest for a while, assemble your gear with our local Sherpa team, and begin the trek. The trail descends through terraced landscapes, traditional Sherpa hamlets, carved mani stones, and prayer wheels along the Dudh Koshi River bank. Cross sturdy suspension bridges over the river and reach Phakding in 3 hours. Stay overnight at Lodge in Phakding.

itinerary.title: Phakding - Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
Following breakfast, prepare for a 5 to 6-hour trek to Namche Bazaar. The trail follows the Dudh Koshi River, crossing high suspension bridges decorated with colorful prayer flags. Walk through pine and rhododendron forests, passing small Sherpa hamlets like Benkar and Tok Tok with views of Thamserku (6,608 m). Arrive at Monjo (2,835 m) to register permits at Sagarmatha National Park entrance.

Enjoy lunch in Jorsalle before tackling the famous double-decked Hillary Suspension Bridge over the river confluence. Begin a steep, zig-zag climb through pine forests, catching your first view of Mount Everest through the trees. Emerge into the vibrant crescent-shaped mountain amphitheater of Namche Bazaar (3,440 m). Explore local bakeries, shops, and cafes in the evening. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization & Hike to Everest View Hotel (3880 m)
itinerary.details:
Today is an essential acclimatization day in Namche Bazaar to help your body adapt to the elevation. Staying active helps speed up acclimatization. In the morning, embark on a scenic 4-hour hike up to Syangboche, Khumjung village, and the famous Everest View Hotel (3,880 m)—one of the highest luxury hotels in the world.

From the hotel terrace, enjoy breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views of Mount Everest, Ama Dablam, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Thamserku. Visit Khumjung Monastery to view the historical yeti scalp and stop by the Hillary School. Return to Namche in the afternoon to explore local markets, craft shops, and bakeries. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazar – Phortse Tenga (3680 m) – Dole (4200 m)
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, begin your trek toward Dole via Phortse Tenga (6–7 hours total). The trail ascends along high mountain contours to Mongla Pass (3,972 m), a picturesque high ridge adorned with chortens. Stop here to rest, take photos, and enjoy magnificent views of Ama Dablam, Phortse, and Kantega.

Descend steeply for an hour to Phortse Tenga by the riverbank for lunch. Afterward, undertake a 2 to 3-hour steep climb through rhododendron, birch, and bamboo forests. Pass wooden bridges, waterfalls, and yak pastures along the trial until reaching the high alpine settlement of Dole (4,200 m). Stay overnight at Lodge in Dole.

itinerary.title: Dole – Machermo (4470 m)
itinerary.details:
Depart Dole after breakfast for a 4 to 5-hour trek to Machermo. The trail ascends steeply above the tree line to 4,000 meters, offering retro views of Dole village and the deep valley below. Walk through high summer pastures of Labharma and Luza, with constant stunning views of Ama Dablam, Thamserku, and Cho Oyu.

Follow the contouring high ridge above the river canyon to reach Machermo (4,470 m) by lunchtime. After lunch and rest, you can take an optional afternoon hike to nearby ridges for acclimatization and glacier valley photography. Stay overnight at Lodge in Machermo.

itinerary.title: Machermo – Gokyo (4790 m)
itinerary.details:
Trek from Machermo to Gokyo Valley (4–5 hours). The trail climbs gently past high alpine terrain before ascending steep rocky steps beside the roaring meltwater of the terminal moraine of Ngozumpa Glacier.

Pass the First Gokyo Lake (Longponga) and Second Gokyo Lake (Taujung), marveling at their intense turquoise blue waters against the snow-capped mountain backdrop. Arrive at the Third Gokyo Lake (Dudh Pokhari) and check into your lodge in Gokyo village (4,790 m). Spend the afternoon exploring the glacier edge and lake shore. Stay overnight at Lodge in Gokyo.

itinerary.title: Gokyo – Gokyo Ri (5360 m) - Thagnag (4700 m)
itinerary.details:
Wake early at 4:30 AM for the 3-hour steep summit hike up Gokyo Ri (5,360 m). Reaching the summit flags rewards you with one of the most stunning Himalayan panoramas on Earth, featuring four 8,000-meter giants: Mt. Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu, as well as the turquoise Gokyo Lakes and Ngozumpa Glacier below.

Descend back to Gokyo for breakfast and a short rest. Afterwards, pack up and trek across the Ngozumpa Glacier moraine toward Thagnag (4,700 m). Navigate boulder-strewn glacial paths for 3 hours, preparing for the high pass crossing the next day. Stay overnight at Lodge in Thagnag.

itinerary.title: Thagnag – Chola Pass (5330 m) – Dzonglha (4830 m)
itinerary.details:
Today is one of the most thrilling days of the trek as you cross Chola Pass (5,330 m). Start early at 4:30 AM after breakfast. Climb steeply over rocky scree and ice-draped slopes for 3 hours to reach the summit of Chola Pass.

Standing atop Chola Pass (5,330 m), admire magnificent views of Cho Oyu, Cholatse, Baruntse, and Ama Dablam. After taking photos and enjoying a packed lunch, carefully descend the eastern side of the pass down boulder fields into the peaceful high valley of Dzonglha (4,830 m). Stay overnight at Lodge in Dzonglha.

itinerary.title: Dzonglha – Gorakshep (5140 m)
itinerary.details:
Depart Dzonglha after breakfast, enjoying views of towering peaks including Cholatse (6,440 m), Taboche (6,495 m), and Lobuche (6,119 m). Contour along the high ridge above Cholatse Lake to join the main Everest Base Camp trail at Lobuche.

After a break in Lobuche, trek along the rocky lateral moraine of the Khumbu Glacier. Walk past glacial debris and ice towers for 3 hours to reach Gorak Shep (5,140 m), the final accommodation stop before Base Camp. Check into the lodge, rest, and prepare for Base Camp and Kala Patthar. Stay overnight at Lodge in Gorakshep.

itinerary.title: Gorakshep – Kala Patthar (5545 m) – EBC (5360 m) - Lobuche (4910 m)
itinerary.details:
Wake before dawn (4 AM) for the challenging climb up Kala Patthar (5,545 m). Watch golden sunrise rays illuminate the South Face of Mount Everest (8,848.86 m), Nuptse, and Pumori in a 360-degree panorama. Descend back to Gorak Shep for breakfast.

After breakfast, trek across the Khumbu Glacier moraine to Everest Base Camp (5,360 m). Stand beside the iconic EBC rock marker, take team photos, view the Khumbu Icefall, and return down to Lobuche (4,910 m) for the night. Stay overnight at Lodge in Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Lobuche - Tengboche (3860 m)
itinerary.details:
Following breakfast, begin your descent down the Khumbu valley from Lobuche toward Tengboche (7–8 hours). The route passes Thokla Pass memorial ridge and Pheriche, crossing the Imja Khola River via a wooden bridge.

Climb up through birch and rhododendron forests to reach Tengboche (3,860 m). Visit the iconic Tengboche Monastery in the afternoon, meet the Buddhist monks, observe evening prayers, and admire views of Ama Dablam. Stay overnight at Lodge in Tengboche.

itinerary.title: Tengboche (3860 m) – Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
Descend from Tengboche through pine forests down to Phunki Tenga by the riverbank. Cross the suspension bridge over the Dudh Koshi River and climb the high contouring trail around the ridge back to Namche Bazaar (3,440 m).

Enjoy a hot shower, fresh espresso, apple pie at local bakeries, and celebrate completing the high passes and Everest Base Camp. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche Bazar.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazar – Phakding – Lukla (2840 m)
itinerary.details:
On your final day on the trekking trail, descend steeply down from Namche Bazaar, crossing the Hillary Suspension Bridge and walking back along the Dudh Koshi River bank. Pass through Monjo and Phakding (lunch stop).

Make the final gradual uphill climb back to Lukla town (2,860 m). Gather with your guide and Sherpa porter crew in the evening for a celebratory farewell dinner. Stay overnight at Lodge in Lukla.

itinerary.title: Lukla - Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details:
Take an early morning flight from Lukla Airport back to Kathmandu (or Ramechhap during peak season). Enjoy your final aerial view of the Himalayan mountain range during the flight.

Upon arrival in Kathmandu, our representative will transfer you back to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day resting and recovering. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Free Day & Sightseeing
itinerary.details:

- Swoyambhunath (Monkey Temple): Panoramic views of Kathmandu valley.
- Boudhanath: One of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world.
- Pashupatinath: Sacred Hindu temple complex on the Bagmati River.

Spend the evening shopping for souvenirs in Thamel. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu

At your scheduled departure time, our representative will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) approximately 3 hours before your international flight departure. Board your flight home carrying lifelong memories of your 17-Day Everest Base Camp, Gokyo Lakes & Chola Pass adventure!

faqs.question: What is Renjo La Pass?
faqs.answer: Renjo La Pass (5,340 m) is one of the high mountain passes in the Everest region connecting the remote Bhote Koshi valley with the Gokyo Lakes valley. It offers breathtaking panoramic views of Mt. Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu.

faqs.question: What is the depth of Gokyo Lake?
faqs.answer: Gokyo Lake (Dudh Pokhari) is part of the world's highest freshwater lake system situated at an elevation of 4,700–5,000 meters. The maximum depth of Gokyo Main Lake is approximately 43 meters (141 ft).

faqs.question: How difficult is the Everest Gokyo & Renjo La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: The trek is graded as Moderate to Hard. Trekkers walk 5–7 hours per day at altitudes exceeding 4,000–5,300 meters. Good physical fitness and mental determination are required, but no technical climbing skills are needed.

faqs.question: When is the best time to do the Everest Gokyo & Renjo La Trek?
faqs.answer: Spring (March to May) and Autumn (September to November) offer optimal weather, clear skies, and comfortable trekking temperatures.

faqs.question: Do I need a guide for this Everest - Renjo La Pass trek?
faqs.answer: Yes, having a licensed English-speaking local guide is strongly recommended for high-altitude safety, navigating high passes, permit arrangements, and local cultural interaction.

faqs.question: Can I combine this trek with Everest Base Camp?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can combine Gokyo and Renjo La Pass with Everest Base Camp via the Cho La Pass on our 17-Day Everest Base Camp Trek with Gokyo - Chola Pass.

faqs.question: What currency shall I carry during Gokyo-Renjo La pass trek?
faqs.answer: You should carry Nepalese Rupees (NPR) in cash for personal expenses, hot showers, Wi-Fi, battery charging, and snacks during the trek, as ATMs are only available up to Namche Bazaar.

faqs.question: What kind of accommodation will I get during the Gokyo-Renjo La Pass Lake Trek?
faqs.answer: Accommodations are cozy local tea house lodges with twin-sharing rooms, warm dining halls, and shared or attached bathroom facilities in lower villages.

faqs.question: What kind of food is available during the Gokyo-Renjo La Pass Trek?
faqs.answer: Lodges serve a variety of fresh meals including local Dal Bhat, Chowmein, Fried Rice, Pasta, Momo, Pancakes, Soups, Eggs, and Hot Beverages.

faqs.question: Will I get vegetarian or vegan meal options during Gokyo-Renjo La Pass Trek?

faqs.question: Can I get hot shower facilities during the Gokyo Renjo La Pass trek?

tourTrips.title: Gokyo and Renjo La Pass Trek - 13 Days
tourTrips.destination: Gokyo & Renjo La Pass, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Scenic, quieter high-pass trek to turquoise Gokyo Lakes, Gokyo Ri (5,360 m), and across the breathtaking Renjo La Pass (5,340 m).
tourTrips.description:
Gokyo and Renjo La Pass Trek in Nepal of 13 days is a scenic alternative trek to the classic EBC route, offering spectacular views of Everest, Cho Oyu, Makalu, and more. This trek is less crowded compared to the Everest Base Camp route and features the thrilling high-altitude Renjo La Pass (5,340 m), providing breathtaking Himalayan scenery and vistas of the amazing turquoise glacial lakes of Gokyo.

Gokyo and Renjo La Pass trek in Everest is a short, beautiful trek blending natural wonders with the Sherpa culture of the Khumbu region. During this trek, you pass through beautiful villages like Lukla, Phakding, Namche Bazaar, Thame, and Lungden before crossing the high Renjo La Pass. After descending to Gokyo Lake (4,790 m), a hike to Gokyo Ri (5,360 m) offers one of the best Himalayan panoramas.

Explore Gokyo Lakes & Cross Renjo La Pass | Stunning Alternative to EBC Trek

The Gokyo and Renjo La Pass trek is a scenic and less crowded journey in the Khumbu region of Nepal, offering stunning views of Mount Everest and other Himalayan peaks. The main highlight is crossing the high and beautiful Renjo La Pass (5,340 m), which offers one of the best mountain views in Nepal.

The trek starts with a scenic flight to Lukla (2,840 m), followed by a walk to Phakding along the Dudh Koshi River. From there, the trail continues to Namche Bazaar (3,440 m). After acclimatization, the trail heads west to the peaceful, quiet Sherpa village of Thame and on to Lungden (4,380 m).

From Lungden, you cross the challenging Renjo La Pass (5,340 m) and descend to the beautiful Gokyo Lake (4,790 m). A short hike up Gokyo Ri (5,360 m) gives you a stunning sunrise view of Everest, Cho Oyu, Makalu, and other peaks before descending down through Dole and Namche to Lukla.

When is the Best Time for Gokyo & Renjo La Pass Trekking?

The best time to do this trek is in Spring (March–May) and Autumn (September–November). December is also a great option for those who prefer fewer crowds. While demanding due to high altitude, with proper guidance and preparation, it offers a once-in-a-lifetime Himalayan experience.

Who Can Do This Trek?

The Everest Gokyo & Renjo La Pass Trek can be done by anyone with good fitness, a sense of adventure, and a positive mindset. It is ideal for beginners with good fitness & willpower, trekkers with past experience (e.g. Poon Hill, Langtang, Mardi Himal), as well as solo travelers, couples, and groups seeking a quieter, scenic high-pass route.

Alternatives for Gokyo & Renjo La Pass Trek

If you are exploring other options in the Everest region, consider:

  • Everest Base Camp Trek & Return by Heli – 12 Days
  • Everest Base Camp Trek – 15 Days
  • Everest Base Camp Trek with Gokyo – Chola Pass – 17 Days
  • Everest Three Passes Trek – 19 Days
  • Everest View Short Trek – 7 Days

Lukla Flight Information

Flight from Ramechhap (March, April, May, October & November): During peak seasons, flights operate from Ramechhap Airport to avoid air traffic in Kathmandu. Includes a 5-6 hour drive from Kathmandu to Ramechhap followed by a 20-minute flight to Lukla.

Flight from Kathmandu (December – February & June – September): Direct 35-minute flight from Kathmandu's Tribhuvan International Airport to Lukla.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Once checked in, we will arrange a pre-trip meeting where we will brief in short about the trek, answer any queries you have and meet your trekking guide as well. After the short brief, you can relax and spend rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Lukla (2840 m) – Phakding (2610 m)
itinerary.details: This day after an early breakfast at the hotel, we will meet our guide and drive to the domestic terminal of Tribhuvan International Airport for a 35-minute scenic and adventurous flight to Lukla in the Everest region, weather permitting. Upon landing at Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla (2840 m), we will rest briefly, meet our Sherpas at the lodge, and begin our trek. The three-hour walk to Phakding (2610m) will take us through Lukla Bazaar, offering unforgettable views of terraced landscapes, river valleys, Sherpa villages, and up-close perspectives of some of the world's highest mountains. Stay overnight at a lodge.

itinerary.title: Phakding - Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details: This day we will have breakfast in early morning and trek towards Namche Bazzar. At the beginning of the trek, we have to walk straight uphill path and we will cross the Dudh Koshi river several times. After walking about 1.5 hours we will reach Monjo village (2835 m). Then we will continue our trek with a steep zig-zag trial crossing the waterfall, crossing biggest and amazing suspension bridge. After almost 5 to 6 hours of walking we will reach Namche Bazar, the capital of Sherpa people. The first view of Namche Bazar with the stupa, monastery, lodges and the beautiful gates is amazing. Stay overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization at Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
Today will be the acclimatization day in Namche Bazar. As trekking in higher elevations can lead to altitude sickness, we have to make sure to acclimatize so that our body can adapt with increasing elevation.

In the morning, we will have breakfast in the hotel and get ready to hike for about 4 hours to the monastery above Namche Bazar, then after we will go to Syangboche and Khumjung village and finally to the luxurious hotel at highest altitude: Hotel Everest View. From the hotel, we can see first view of Mount Everest, and other beautiful Himalayas like: Mount Ama Dablam, Mount Lhotse, Mount Nuptse and so on.

Today's hike will serve us for acclimatization and where we will enjoy magnificent views of Everest. As we return back to Namche Bazar, in the afternoon we will have free time to wander around and visit the markets, purchase trekking equipment's (if needed), local handicrafts and so on around Namche Bazar. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazzar - Thame (3800 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast at the lodge and then begin the trek to Thame which takes about 4-5 hours of walking.

Following Bhote Koshi River along the pine and rhododendron forests, we trek towards Thame. On the way you can see large set of prayer flags, Chorten, carved stones, stupa at Phurte and so on.

Thame is located at the end of the Khumbu Valley and the iconic value of Thame is its terrain of peoples who are untouched by the effects of modern civilization. On the way to Thame, you can visit a place named Thamu where there is Ani Monastery, we can visit there on the way and we reach Thame we can visit the older monastery of Everest Region, 'Dechen Chokhorling Monastery Thame'. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Thame - Lungden (4380m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast at the lodge and then trek towards Lungden which takes about 5-6 hours.

Today's walking is mostly uphill trials, enjoying the view of landscape, vegetation and mountains. During the trek you pass through old Sherpa walled villages like Taranga, then Marulung (4200 m) and finally reach Lungden. Today you will also be able to observe Sherpa culture en route. We can also visit Nakpa valley which used to be old trade route to Tibet and also share the road with Tibetan Yak Caravan as it is the road to and from Namche with trade to Tibet with the villagers. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Lungden – Renjola Pass (5340 m) – Gokyo (4790 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in the early morning (around 5 am) and get ready to cross Renjo La Pass (5340 m). Today you will have to trek for about 6-7 hours to reach Gokyo.

Today's trekking will be mostly uphill trial until you reach Renjo La Pass. From the top of Renjo La Pass (5340 m), you can see majestic views of towering peaks such as Mount Everest (8848 m), Mount Lhotse (8516 m), Mount Nuptse, Mount Makalu (8463 m), and Mount Cho Oyu (8201 m) and many more.

After enjoying the view from Renjola pass you start to descend towards Gokyo, and reach Gokyo in another 2 hours. Upon arrival in Gokyo valley, you can also admire the Gokyo Lake with the picturesque Gokyo village nestled along its shores from the pass. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Gokyo – Gokyo Ri (5360 m) - Dole (4200 m)
itinerary.details:
Today is one of the important day of the trekking. You will have to wake up in the early morning (4:30 – 5 am) and then get ready to hike 1.8 km uphill to Gokyo Ri (5360 m) which takes about 3 hours.

Climbing Gokyo Ri is totally ascending uphill trial but the view from the top of Gokyo Ri is totally worth it! We can enjoy the panoramic view of the Himalayas like Mount Everest, Mount Makalu, Mount Lhotse, Ama Dablam, Thamserku and so on. Along with the views of magnificent peaks, you can also see glaciers and very beautiful views of Gokyo Lakes. After enjoying the view from Gokyo Ri, descend back to Gokyo in lodge which takes about 1.5 hours.

After arrival in the lodge in Gokyo, you will have breakfast and rest for a while. Then prepare to trek back towards Dole which takes about 5 hours of walking. Today you will descend back towards Dole and trek alongside Dudh Koshi River to reach Dole. On the way you can see beautiful views of Cho Oyu, Kangtega, Thamserku, Taboche and Cholatse peaks. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Dole - Namche Bazaar (3440 m)
itinerary.details: This day after having breakfast, trek towards Namche Bazaar which takes about 6 hours. You will walk zig-zag trials till we reach Namche Bazaar crossing Phortse and Phunke Tenga. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar – Lukla (2840 m)
itinerary.details:
After having breakfast in the lodge, you will descend back towards Lukla through the same trail via Phakding. As you trek back to Lukla you get to spend the last night in the Khumbu region of Everest. You will descend towards Phakding from Namche in about 3.5 hours and have lunch in Phakding. From here, we will again descend towards Lukla through the zigzag trail in another 4.5 hours.

Upon arrival in Lukla, enjoy your last stay in Khumbu region, have group dinner and enjoy your final stay with warm memories and lifetime adventure in Khumbu region just spent. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Lukla – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Today in the early morning (6 am onwards) you will take a flight from Tenzing Hillary Airport (an 'eagle's nest') to fly to Kathmandu or Ramechhap (subject to availability). The time of the flight will depend on the weather conditions. After arrival in Kathmandu, you can rest the whole day. Stay overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.details:
This day you have a free day in Kathmandu. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

Taking advantage of the extra day, you can go for:
- UNESCO World Heritage sightseeing (Swayambhunath, Boudhanath, Pashupatinath)
- Panoramic Mount Everest Mountain flight to see beautiful views of Everest range
- Shopping / Massage, rest in hotel, etc.

NOTE: In case travellers do not need an extra day in Kathmandu, it is possible to reduce 1 extra night in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Enjoy your last day in Kathmandu before departure. At your scheduled departure time, our correspondent will pick you up from the hotel, transfer you to the airport, and bid you farewell with warm hearts.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Once checked in, we will arrange a pre-trip meeting where we will brief in short about the trek, answer any queries you have and meet your trekking guide as well. After the short brief, you can relax and spend rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at the Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Lukla (2840 m) – Phakding (2610 m)
itinerary.details:
This day after an early breakfast at the hotel, meet your guide and drive to the domestic terminal of Tribhuvan International Airport for a 35-minute scenic and adventurous flight to Lukla in the Everest region, weather permitting.

Upon landing at Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla (2840 m), rest briefly in the lodge of Lukla and meet your Sherpas at the lodge, and prepare to begin the first day trek to Everest Base Camp. Walking 3 hours some ascending and straight trials you reach Phakding (2610m). Along the way you pass through Lukla Bazaar, offering unforgettable views of terraced landscapes, river valleys, Sherpa villages, and up-close perspectives of some of the world's highest mountains. Stay overnight at a lodge in Phakding.

itinerary.title: Phakding - Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in the early morning and begin the journey towards Namche Bazzar which takes about 5-6 hours of walking.

At the beginning of the trek, you have to walk straight uphill path and then cross the Dudh Koshi River several times. After walking for about 1.5 hours you will reach Monjo village (2835 m). Then from Monjo continue the trek along steep zig-zag trial. On the way you cross waterfall, pass through one of the biggest and amazing suspension bridge. After almost 5 to 6 hours of walking you will reach Namche Bazar.

Namche Bazar is the main gateway to Nepal's Himalayas of Everest region. Namche Bazar is also known as "Sherpa capital," - a vibrant town known for its stunning mountain views, cultural richness, and importance as a trading and acclimatization hub. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche Bazar.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization at Namche Bazar & Hike to Everest View Hotel (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
Today will be the acclimatization day in Namche Bazar. As trekking in higher elevations can lead to altitude sickness, you have to make sure to acclimatize so that your body can adapt with increasing elevation.

In the morning, after breakfast in the hotel, get ready to hike for about 4 hours to the monastery above Namche Bazar. Then your guide will accompany you to Syangboche and Khumjung village and finally to the luxurious hotel at highest altitude: Everest View Hotel. From the hotel, you can see first view of Mount Everest, and other beautiful Himalayas like: Mount Ama Dablam, Mount Lhotse, Mount Nuptse and so on. You can rest and have some tea in the hotel.

Today will be the first day when you get to enjoy magnificent views of mighty Mount Everest (8848 m). As you return back to Namche Bazar, in the afternoon you will have free time to wander around and visit the markets, purchase trekking equipment's (if needed), local handicrafts and so on around Namche Bazar. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche Bazzar.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar - Tengboche (3860 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in morning and then begin the journey to Tengboche which takes about 5 hours of walking.

Today trek will be through the most scenic route of Everest from where we can see Dudh Koshi River and on the way, you can see scenic view of Mount Ama Dablam, Mount Lhotse, Mount Nuptse, Mount Everest, Mount Kangtega, Thamserku and many more. As you leave Namche Bazar, walk through the descending trial along the Dudh Koshi valley until you reach Phungi Thanga. You get to see most amazing view of Mount Ama Dablam and monastery near Phungi Thanga, a best place to take the picture of nature, mountain and monastery. After resting for a while in Phungi Thanga, cross the suspension bridge and walk uphill trial for about 3 hours to reach Tengboche.

Tengboche is one of the famous destinations with old monastery for the travelers in khumbu region of Nepal, here you can visit the Tengboche monastery and pray with monks in the evening or morning with Lamas. Stay overnight at Lodge in Tengboche.

itinerary.title: Tengboche - Dingboche (4410 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you have breakfast in morning gear yourself to trek towards Dingboche which takes about 5-6 hours of walking.

Before you head to Dingboche, you can see mesmerizing view of sunrise on Mount Amadablam, Mount Everest, Mount Lhotse and Thamserku from Tengboche. You have to walk through the alpine forest crossing Imja Khola (river) through the suspension bridge on the way to reach Dingboche. You will also pass through different villages like: Debuche, Pangboche before Dingboche Village. On the way you can also see mani walls, prayer flags, yaks grazing, and so on.

Dingboche is a beautiful village with settlement of Sherpa people in Everest region of Nepal. It is also known as "summer valley" due to its warmer sun exposure compared to neighboring villages. Dingboche is a common acclimatization point for trekkers heading toward Everest Base Camp, Island Peak, or Ama Dablam. Stay overnight at Lodge in Dingboche.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Dingboche (4410 m)
itinerary.details:
Today is a rest and acclimatization day in Dingboche. Though today is a "rest day," it's important to stay active for acclimatization.

To adapt with the altitude and changing environment and prevent ourselves from altitude sickness, we can hike to Nangkartsang peak (5083 m) which takes about 3.5 hours to reach there and 2 hours to descend back. This hike is a great opportunity to see amazing views of Makalu (8,485 m), Lhotse (8,516 m), Ama Dablam (6,812 m), Island Peak, and Cho Oyu (8,188 m) on a clear day.

After the hike, return to Dingboche for a relaxed afternoon. You can explore the village, interact with the local Sherpa people, or rest at the lodge. The landscape around Dingboche, with its traditional stone walls, potato fields, and wide open valleys, is both peaceful and picturesque. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Dingboche - Lobuche (4940 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in morning and then prepare to continue the journey to Lobuche which takes about 5 hours of walking uphill trials.

You have to walk through the straight ascending trial to climb towards Pheriche valley. Passing through the alpine scrub and yak pastures along with the beautiful view of mountains behind. You can see the memorial statues of climbers who passed away during expeditions in Everest and then from there walking further, you reach Thukla Pass. You will rest there for a while and begin to walk towards Lobuche. Here, in Lobuche you will have basic place for lodging. Stay overnight at Lodge in Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Lobuche - EBC (5360 m) - Gorak Shep (5140 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in early morning and then hike for about 2 hours to reach Gorakshep. From Lobuche we have to walk through rocky ways, uphill trial to reach Gorakshep. Today is one of the important days of the Everest Base Camp trek where you will be able to reach the foot of world tallest mountain - Mount Everest's base camp - EBC.

As we reach Gorakshep, we will keep our luggage in the lodge and then go to the main destination of the trek, Everest Base Camp (5360 m). If weather is clear, you can see amazing views of Mount Everest followed by Mount Nuptse, Mount Lhotse and so on. Also, you can see Khumbu Glaciers from here. After enjoying the scenic view in EBC return back to Gorakshep. Stay overnight at Lodge in Gorakshep.

itinerary.title: Gorak Shep - Kala Patthar (5550 m) – Lukla (2840 m) – Kathmandu (1350 m) by Heli
itinerary.details:
Today is one of the most adventurous and thrilling days of the Everest Base Camp trek, where you will reach the maximum altitude of the trek - Kala Patthar (5,545 m).

You will wake up in the early morning (4-5am) and begin to hike towards Kala Patthar, the viewpoint of the trek. Walking uphill trial for about 2.5 hours you will reach Kala Patthar - meaning "Black Stone" in Nepali. When you are ascending towards Kala Patthar you can see Mount Pumori right straight to your sight. From the top you can see beautiful 360-degree views of the Everest Range: Mount Everest, Mount Nuptse, Mount Lhotse, Mount Pumori, Mount Ama Dablam and many more.

After celebrating and capturing the successful climb to Kala Patthar, descend back to the lodge and have breakfast. After breakfast, prepare to return back to Kathmandu and wait for the Helicopter to arrive at the Heli pad of Kala Patthar / Gorak Shep and fly back to Kathmandu (stopover in Lukla for refueling). Transfer to your hotel upon landing in Kathmandu. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.details:
Free day in Kathmandu for sightseeing / shopping / massage. We can do half-day sightseeing in UNESCO-listed World Heritage sites like:

- Kathmandu Durbar Square: Historical, cultural, and religious heritage site with amazing architecture.
- Swoyambhunath (Monkey Temple): Offers panoramic views of Kathmandu valley.
- Boudhanath: One of the largest stupas in the world.
- Pashupatinath: Sacred Hindu temple complex on the banks of the Bagmati River.

Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Enjoy your last day in Kathmandu before departure. At your scheduled departure time, our correspondent will pick you up from the hotel, transfer you to the airport, and bid you farewell with warm hearts.

essentialInfo.title: Permits Required for Everest Base Camp Trekking with Helicopter Return
essentialInfo.content:
For travelers doing the Everest Base Camp Trek with Helicopter Return, you will need two main permits:

• Sagarmatha National Park Entry Permit: Required to enter the park covering EBC, Kala Patthar, and Khumbu glacier.
• Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Permit: Local permit required to trek in the Khumbu region.

Note: The TIMS card is no longer required for treks in the Everest region. At Asian Adventure Treks & Expedition, we arrange all permits in advance!

essentialInfo.title: Best Time for Everest Base Camp Trek with Heli Return
essentialInfo.content:
• Spring (March – May): Stable weather, moderate temperatures, vibrant rhododendron blooms, clear mountain views, and active Everest expeditions.
• Autumn (September – November): Crisp blue skies, dry conditions, clear visibility, and comfortable trekking weather.
• Winter (December – February): Off-season with fewer crowds, serene mountain views, pristine snowy vistas, and direct Lukla flights from Kathmandu.

essentialInfo.title: Weather & Temperature Guide
essentialInfo.content:
• Spring (March - May): Daytime 10°C to 15°C at lower altitudes; nighttime -10°C to -15°C at Gorak Shep / Kala Patthar.
• Autumn (Sept - Nov): Daytime 10°C to 20°C at lower altitudes; nighttime -10°C or lower at high camps.
• Winter (Dec - Feb): Daytime 5°C to 10°C; nighttime -15°C to -20°C above 4,000 meters. Clear skies with minimal crowds.

essentialInfo.title: Meals & Accommodations During EBC Trek
essentialInfo.content:
Trekkers stay in cozy mountain tea house lodges with twin beds, blankets, and shared or attached bathrooms (Namche, Lukla, Dingboche). Dining halls are heated with central stoves.

• Breakfast: Bread, Muesli, Porridge, Pancakes, Tibetan Bread, Chapati, Eggs, Sandwiches with tea/coffee.
• Lunch: Chowmein, Fried Rice, Pasta, French Fries, Momo, Spring Rolls, Pizza, Soups with tea/coffee.
• Dinner: Soups (Mushroom, Garlic, Veg) + Main Course (Macaroni, Pasta, Fried Rice, Spaghetti, Momo, Nepali Dal Bhat) with tea/coffee.

essentialInfo.title: Difficulty Level & High-Altitude Acclimatization
essentialInfo.content:
Graded as MODERATE (Grade 2). Suitable for fit beginners and experienced hikers. Max altitude: 5,545 m (Kala Patthar) & 5,140 m sleeping altitude at Gorak Shep.

• Prevention & Remedies for Altitude Sickness (AMS):
- Ascend gradually & take active rest days in Namche (Day 4) and Dingboche (Day 7).
- Hydrate with 3-4 liters of water, garlic/ginger soup, and herbal tea daily.
- Eat carb-rich meals & dress in warm layers.
- Diamox (Acetazolamide) as recommended by your doctor; emergency helicopter rescue insurance required.

faqs.answer: It is a 12-day luxury adventure where you trek up to Everest Base Camp (5,360 m) and Kala Patthar (5,545 m), then fly back directly from Gorakshep / Kala Patthar to Kathmandu by helicopter, skipping the 3-4 day return hike.

faqs.answer: The full itinerary takes 12 days, including 8 days of trekking up to Everest Base Camp and Kala Patthar, followed by a scenic helicopter return flight to Kathmandu on Day 10.

faqs.question: Is the helicopter ride safe in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes, helicopter flights are operated by experienced high-altitude pilots using modern B3e Airbus helicopters tailored for mountain terrain.

faqs.answer: The helicopter return flight is included in your package and pre-arranged by our team when you book the trek.

faqs.question: How long do we walk each day during Everest Base Camp Trek?
faqs.answer: Trekkers walk approximately 5 to 6 hours each day along well-established trails with gradual altitude gains and acclimatization days.

faqs.answer: Helicopters have a weight limit of 10 to 15 kg per passenger for personal luggage on high-altitude flights.

faqs.answer: Clean, cozy tea house lodges with twin-sharing rooms, warm dining halls, and shared or attached bathroom facilities in lower Sherpa villages.

faqs.answer: Yes, Wi-Fi access (Airship/Everest Link cards) is available at most lodges along the route for a small daily fee.

tourTrips.destination: Gokyo Lakes, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Trek to the turquoise Gokyo Glacial Lakes, climb Gokyo Ri (5,360 m), and explore the 5th Lake and Ngozumpa Glacier.
tourTrips.description:
The Gokyo Lake Trek of 14 days is a spectacular journey in the Everest region that leads trekkers to a series of pristine glacial lakes nestled at high altitudes, including the stunning Gokyo Lakes and the viewpoint of Gokyo Ri (5,360 m). This trek offers breathtaking views of the world’s highest peaks like Mount Everest, Mount Lhotse, Mount Makalu, and Cho Oyu—while passing through remote Sherpa villages, alpine valleys, and the massive Ngozumpa Glacier. Gokyo Ri provides one of the best panoramic vistas in the Himalayas, making this a perfect alternative to the classic Everest Base Camp trek.

Ideal for those seeking less crowded trails and natural beauty, the Gokyo Lake Trek typically takes 11 days of actual trekking from/to Lukla and reaches a maximum altitude of over 5,360 meters. The trek is moderately challenging and suitable for trekkers with good fitness and high-altitude enthusiasm.

Gokyo Lake Trek Nepal: Glacial Lakes, Everest Views & Sherpa Culture

The Gokyo Lake Trek of 14 days is a short alternative trek option in the Everest Region where we explore the 5 main lakes of Gokyo lying between 4,700 m to 5,000 m altitude. These lakes form the world’s highest freshwater lake system, designated as a Ramsar site of international importance and sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists. Lonely Planet praises the Gokyo Valley as "the most spectacular in the Khumbu."

The trek climbs to Gokyo Ri (5,360 m), offering a 360-degree panoramic view of Everest alongside the turquoise Gokyo Lakes and Gokyo village below. The trail passes through Namche Bazaar, Dole, Phortse, and Machhermo.

Lukla Flight Information

Flight from Ramechhap (March, April, May, October & November): During peak seasons, flights operate from Ramechhap Airport to avoid air traffic in Kathmandu. Includes a 5-6 hour drive from Kathmandu to Ramechhap followed by a 20-minute flight to Lukla.

Flight from Kathmandu (December – February & June – September): Direct 35-minute flight from Kathmandu's Tribhuvan International Airport to Lukla.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Once checked in, we will arrange a pre-trip meeting where we will brief in short about the trek, answer any queries you have and meet your trekking guide as well. After the short brief, you can relax and spend rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Lukla (2840 m) – Phakding (2610 m)
itinerary.details:
This day we will have breakfast early in the morning then our guide will pick us up and take us to the domestic terminal of TIA for an exciting 35-minute mountain flight to Lukla in eastern Nepal.

Upon landing at Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla, rest for a while, meet our Sherpas, and prepare to begin the trek to Phakding (2610 m). The 2 to 3-hour walk takes us through Lukla Bazaar, offering unforgettable views of terraced landscapes, river valleys, Sherpa villages, and suspension bridges. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Phakding - Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in the morning and prepare to head towards Namche Bazar which takes about 5-6 hours.

Walk along the low-rise trail crossing the Dudh Koshi River several times. Pass Monjo village (2835 m) to enter Sagarmatha National Park. Ascend the steep zig-zag path, cross high suspension bridges, and catch your first glimpse of Mount Everest. Have lunch in Jorsalle before making the final push to Namche Bazaar (3440 m), the bustling capital of the Sherpa people. Free evening to explore bakeries, cafes, and local shops. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization & Hike to Everest View Hotel (3880 m)
itinerary.details:
Today is an essential acclimatization day in Namche Bazaar. In the morning, hike up to Syangboche, Khumjung village, and the famous Everest View Hotel (3,880 m)—the world's highest luxury hotel.

Enjoy 360-degree views of Mount Everest, Ama Dablam, Lhotse, Nuptse, and Thamserku while sipping hot tea on the hotel terrace. Return to Namche Bazaar in the afternoon for free leisure time to explore markets and bakeries. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar - Phortse Village (3840 m)
itinerary.details: After breakfast, trek towards Phortse Village (5–6 hours). Ascend uphill for 3 hours to reach Mongla Pass (3,972 m), enjoying breathtaking views of Ama Dablam from the stupa. Descend to Phortse Tenga, cross the river, and hike up to Phortse village (3,840 m), a scenic Sherpa village located at the base of Taboche Peak. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Phortse Village – Machhermo (4470 m)
itinerary.details: Trek from Phortse Village to Machhermo (4–5 hours). Cross the Dudh Koshi River and ascend through Luza village, walking alongside high alpine trails with retro views of the valley. Arrive in Machhermo (4,470 m) for lunch and spend the afternoon exploring the surrounding ridge. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Machermo – Gokyo (4790 m)
itinerary.details: Trek from Machermo to Gokyo Valley (4–5 hours). Ascend steep rocky steps beside the roaring meltwater of Ngozumpa Glacier. Pass the 1st Gokyo Lake (Longponga) and marvel at the intense turquoise waters of the 2nd and 3rd lakes (Dudh Pokhari). Check into your lodge in Gokyo village (4,790 m) nestled beside the lake shore. Explore the glacier in the afternoon. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Gokyo - Climb Gokyo Ri (5360 m) – Hike to Fifth Lake
itinerary.details:
Wake early at 4:30 AM for the 3-hour climb up Gokyo Ri (5,360 m). Experience the breathtaking 360-degree sunrise panorama of Mount Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, Ngozumpa Glacier, and the Gokyo Lakes below. Descend back to the lodge for breakfast.

In the afternoon, embark on a scenic hike to the 4th Lake (Thonak Tsho) and 5th Lake (Ngozumpa Tsho) at 5,000 meters elevation for incredible up-close views of Cho Oyu and Mount Everest's North Face. Return to Gokyo for the night. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Gokyo – Dole (4200 m)
itinerary.details: After breakfast, pack up and begin your descent back towards Dole (5 hours walking). Trek alongside the Dudh Koshi River with retro views of Cho Oyu, Kangtega, Thamserku, Taboche, and Cholatse peaks. Stay overnight at Lodge in Dole.

itinerary.title: Dole - Namche Bazaar (3440 m)
itinerary.details: Trek from Dole to Namche Bazaar (6 hours). Walk the zig-zag trail crossing Phortse Tenga and Phungi Thanga before contouring around the high valley ridge back to Namche Bazaar. Enjoy hot showers and bakeries in the evening. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar – Lukla (2840 m)
itinerary.details: Final day on the trekking trail. Descend from Namche Bazaar down to Phakding for lunch, then continue along the river valley to Lukla town (2,840 m). Gather with your guide and Sherpa porters for a celebratory farewell dinner. Stay overnight at Lodge.

itinerary.title: Lukla – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Early morning flight from Lukla Airport back to Kathmandu (or Ramechhap depending on season). Transfer to your hotel upon landing and spend the rest of the day relaxing. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Free day in Kathmandu for leisure, shopping, or UNESCO World Heritage sightseeing including Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), Boudhanath Stupa, and Bhaktapur Durbar Square. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your flight home.

tourTrips.title: Amadablam Base Camp Trek - 11 Days
tourTrips.destination: Ama Dablam Base Camp, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Spectacular 11-day short trek to the base camp of Mount Ama Dablam (4,700 m) beneath one of the world's most iconic mountain pyramids.
tourTrips.description:
Ama Dablam Base Camp Trek of 11 days in the Khumbu region of Nepal is a spectacular short trek in the Everest region, ideal for trekkers seeking a close encounter with the Himalayas. Ama Dablam means 'Mother's Necklace' in English. Without going all the way to Everest Base Camp, this scenic 11-day journey takes you deep into the heart of Sherpa culture, vibrant villages, ancient monasteries, and breathtaking landscapes to the base of Mount Ama Dablam (6,812 m)—one of the most iconic peaks in the world.

From Ama Dablam Base Camp (4,700 m), trekkers are rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views of Himalayan giants set in a wide, open alpine valley. Mount Ama Dablam was first scaled on March 13, 1961, by a team led by Sir Edmund Hillary.

Himalayan Peaks Seen from Ama Dablam Base Camp

  • Ama Dablam (6,812 m): Towering directly above, incredibly close and dramatic
  • Mount Everest (8,848 m): Visible from high points along the trail near Pangboche
  • Lhotse (8,516 m): Standing just south of Everest
  • Kangtega (6,782 m) & Thamserku (6,608 m): Beautiful double summits sharply rising to the southeast
  • Taboche (6,495 m) & Cholatse (6,440 m): Visible across the valley ridges
  • Island Peak (6,189 m) & Peak 38 (7,590 m): Magnificent high mountain vistas

Lukla Flight Information

Flight from Ramechhap (March, April, May, October & November): During peak seasons, flights operate from Ramechhap Airport to avoid air traffic in Kathmandu. Includes a 5-6 hour drive from Kathmandu to Ramechhap followed by a 20-minute flight to Lukla.

Flight from Kathmandu (December – February & June – September): Direct 35-minute flight from Kathmandu's Tribhuvan International Airport to Lukla.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu, you will be greeted by our correspondent who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. Once checked in, we will arrange a pre-trip meeting where we will brief in short about the trek, answer any queries you have and meet your trekking guide as well. After the short brief, you can relax and spend rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at the Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Lukla (2840 m) – Phakding (2610 m)
itinerary.details:
This day after an early breakfast at the hotel, meet your guide and drive to the domestic terminal of Tribhuvan International Airport for a 35-minute scenic and adventurous flight to Lukla in the Everest region, weather permitting.

Upon landing at Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla (2840 m), rest briefly in the lodge of Lukla and meet your Sherpas at the lodge, and prepare to begin the first day trek. Walking 3 hours along terraced landscapes and river valleys, you reach Phakding (2610 m). Pass through Lukla Bazaar with up-close perspectives of snow-capped peaks. Stay overnight at a lodge in Phakding.

itinerary.title: Phakding - Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
This day you will have breakfast in the early morning and begin the journey towards Namche Bazzar which takes about 5-6 hours of walking.

Walk along the Dudh Koshi River, crossing high suspension bridges decorated with prayer flags. Pass Monjo village (2835 m) to register permits at Sagarmatha National Park entry point. Cross the Hillary Suspension Bridge and ascend the steep zig-zag trail to reach Namche Bazaar (3,440 m), the bustling Sherpa capital. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche Bazar.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization at Namche Bazar (3440 m)
itinerary.details:
Today will be the acclimatization day in Namche Bazar. In the morning, get ready to hike for about 4 hours to the monastery above Namche Bazar, then visit Syangboche, Khumjung village, and the famous Everest View Hotel (3,880 m).

Enjoy panoramic views of Mount Everest (8,848 m), Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse while relaxing with hot tea on the terrace. Return to Namche Bazaar in the afternoon for free time to explore local markets and cafes. Stay overnight at Lodge in Namche Bazar.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar – Pangboche (3930 m)
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, trek along the scenic ridge towards Pangboche (6 hours). Enjoy sweeping views of the Dudh Koshi River, Ama Dablam, Everest, Lhotse, and Thamserku. Descend to Phungi Thanga for lunch, then cross the suspension bridge and climb for 3 hours through rhododendron forests to Tengboche Monastery.

Visit Tengboche Monastery to observe monks during prayer rituals. Continue descending 30 minutes to Debuche and another 30 minutes to Pangboche (3,930 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Pangboche.

itinerary.title: Pangboche – Ama Dablam Base Camp (4700 m)
itinerary.details:
Today is the highlight of the journey. After breakfast, begin the 5-hour trek to Ama Dablam Base Camp (4,700 m). Descend towards Imja Khola, cross the suspension bridge, and climb steeply up to Cholungche Kharka viewpoint.

Continue ascending to reach Ama Dablam Base Camp (4,700 m) set directly beneath the towering pyramid of Mount Ama Dablam (6,812 m). Marvel at close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, Nuptse, Lobuche Peak, Taboche, and the Minbo Glacier. Spend the afternoon exploring the open alpine plateau. Stay overnight at lodge in Base Camp / Pangboche.

itinerary.title: Amadablam Base Camp – Tengboche (3860 m) – Monjo (2835 m)
itinerary.details:
After enjoying a sunrise view over Ama Dablam, begin your descent back towards Monjo (8 hours walking). Pass Debuche, Tengboche Monastery, and descend through rhododendron forests to Phunki Thanga.

Climb up to Sanasa and contour around the high trail past Namche Bazaar and the Sagarmatha National Park checkpoint to reach the peaceful village of Monjo (2,835 m). Stay overnight at lodge in Monjo.

itinerary.title: Monjo – Lukla (2840 m)
itinerary.details:
Final trekking day. Descend from Monjo through Sherpa hamlets along the Dudh Koshi River, reaching Phakding in 2.5 hours for lunch.

After lunch, continue the gradual uphill climb for 3 hours to Lukla town (2,840 m). Celebrate completing the Ama Dablam Base Camp trek with your guide and porter crew in the evening. Stay overnight at Lodge in Lukla.

itinerary.title: Lukla – Kathmandu (1350 m)
itinerary.details: Take an early morning flight from Lukla Airport back to Kathmandu (or Ramechhap depending on season). Transfer to your hotel upon arrival and spend the rest of the day relaxing. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Free day in Kathmandu
itinerary.details: Free day in Kathmandu for sightseeing, shopping, or massage. Optional half-day guided tour of UNESCO World Heritage sites including Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), Boudhanath Stupa, and Pashupatinath Temple. Stay overnight at Hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.details: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before your private airport transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) for your flight home.

tourTrips.destination: Pikey Peak, Nepal
tourTrips.shortDescription: Peaceful 9-day trek in lower Solukhumbu offering Sir Edmund Hillary's favorite 360° summit view of Mt. Everest, Makalu, and Kanchenjunga.
tourTrips.description:
Pikey Peak Trek of 9 days is a short and peaceful journey in the lower Solukhumbu (Everest) region of Nepal, known for offering Sir Edmund Hillary’s favorite view of Mount Everest. From the 4,065 m summit, trekkers can enjoy a breathtaking 360-degree panorama of Himalayan giants including Mount Everest (8,848.86 m), Makalu, Lhotse, Kanchenjunga, and Annapurna, especially stunning at sunrise.

This less-traveled trail passes through traditional Sherpa villages, colorful rhododendron forests, ancient monasteries, and sacred mani walls, offering a rich cultural experience without the commercial crowds of Everest Base Camp. Ideal for beginners and experienced hikers alike, the trek can be completed in 9 days and is best enjoyed in spring, autumn, or even quiet December.

Pikey Peak Trek – Best Short Trek for Everest Views & Sherpa Culture

Named after the local Sherpa deity representing the Sky God worshipped during local festivals, Pikey Peak offers a visual and spiritual experience. The trek starts with a scenic drive along the BP highway to Dhap (2,932 m), followed by gradual ascents through Jhapre and Pikey Peak Base Camp (3,640 m).

The highlight is summiting Pikey Peak (4,065 m) for sunrise before descending through alpine meadows to Junbesi, home to the historic Thupten Chholing Monastery. The trek concludes at Phaplu before returning overland to Kathmandu.

Who Can Do The Pikey Peak Trek?

Anyone with a basic level of fitness and a love for nature and culture! It involves moderate altitudes (max 4,065 m) with 4–6 hours of daily walking, well-established teahouses, and no technical climbing skills required.

itinerary.title: Dhap – Jhapre (2820 m)
itinerary.details:
First day of trekking. After breakfast, trek south from Dhap through descending trails for 2 hours to Sigane village. Ascend past Phokte Danda to reach the quiet Sherpa village of Jhapre (2,820 m) for lunch (5 hours walking total).

Jhapre offers a serene atmosphere and beautiful distant views of Mount Everest, Numbur Himal, Makalu, and Baruntse. Explore the local monastery. Stay overnight at lodge in Jhapre.

itinerary.title: Jhapre – Pikey Peak Base Camp (3640 m)
itinerary.details:
Trek from Jhapre to Pikey Peak Base Camp (6 hours, 12 km). The trail climbs through grassy alpine ridges, rhododendron forests, and past long mani walls.

Enjoy sweeping views of Everest and Numbur Himal as you climb closer to Pikey Peak. Reach Pikey Peak Base Camp (3,640 m) by late afternoon. Rest, stay warm, and prepare for tomorrow's early summit hike. Stay overnight at lodge in Pikey Peak Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Pikey Peak BC – Pikey Peak (4065 m) - Junbesi (2700 m)
itinerary.details:

Descend back to Base Camp for breakfast. Pack up and trek downhill through pine forests and alpine meadows for 6 hours to Junbesi (2,700 m), an authentic Sherpa village. Visit the historic Thupten Chholing Monastery. Stay overnight at lodge in Junbesi.

itinerary.title: Junbesi – Ringmo (2720 m)
itinerary.details:
Trek from Junbesi to Ringmo (5 hours, 12 km). Walk along gentle uphill trails through rhododendron forests, passing Buddhist chortens and mani walls.

Arrive in Ringmo (2,720 m) for lunch. In the afternoon, take a 1-hour hike up to Taksindo to explore one of the largest Tibetan monasteries in Solu and enjoy panoramic views before returning to Ringmo. Stay overnight at lodge in Ringmo.

itinerary.title: Ringmo – Phaplu (2469 m)
itinerary.details:
Final trekking day. Ascend through rhododendron forests and descend past terraced farmlands and Sherpa hamlets to Phaplu (2,469 m), taking about 4 hours (9 km).

Phaplu is the district headquarters of Solukhumbu featuring an airstrip, cozy lodges, and ethnic Rai, Limbu, Sherpa, and Magar communities. Celebrate completing the trek. Stay overnight at lodge in Phaplu.

itinerary.details: After breakfast, take a 9 to 10-hour overland drive (270 km) back to Kathmandu in a private jeep. tourTrips.shortDescription: Ideal 10-day short family trek to Everest View Hotel (3,880 m) and Tengboche Monastery offering spectacular panoramas of Mt. Everest.
tourTrips.description:
Everest View Trek of 10 days is one of the best short trekking experiences in Nepal, offering spectacular views of the world’s highest mountains within a relatively short time. This trek is perfect for travelers who wish to experience the beauty of the Everest region without committing to a long and demanding expedition. The journey begins with a scenic flight from Kathmandu to Lukla, followed by a gradual trek through picturesque Sherpa villages, lush pine forests, and dramatic Himalayan landscapes.

Because of its unique combination of towering Himalayan peaks, Sherpa culture, and breathtaking trekking trails, the Everest View Trek in the Khumbu region remains one of the most iconic mountain destinations in the world.

Mount Everest & The Khumbu Region

Mount Everest, the tallest mountain on Earth, standing at 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 ft) above sea level, lies on the border between Nepal and China (Tibet Autonomous Region). Known as “Sagarmatha” in Nepal and “Chomolungma” in Tibet, the Everest region attracts climbers and trekkers from every corner of the globe.

Located in northeastern Nepal within Sagarmatha National Park, the trail follows the classic Everest trekking route along the Dudh Koshi River through Phakding, Namche Bazaar, and up to the world-famous Everest View Hotel (3,880 m) and Tengboche Monastery (3,860 m).

Lukla Flight Information

Flight from Ramechhap (March, April, May, October & November): During peak seasons, flights operate from Ramechhap Airport to avoid air traffic in Kathmandu. Includes a 5-6 hour drive from Kathmandu to Ramechhap followed by a 20-minute flight to Lukla.

Flight from Kathmandu (December – February & June – September): Direct 35-minute flight from Kathmandu's Tribhuvan International Airport to Lukla.

Panoramic views of Himalayan giants including Mount Everest (8,848.86 m), Lhotse, Ama Dablam, and Thamserku
Visit the vibrant Sherpa town of Namche Bazaar, the cultural and commercial center of the Khumbu region
Walk through the beautiful pine forests and landscapes of UNESCO World Heritage Sagarmatha National Park

Experience traditional Sherpa culture, ancient monasteries, prayer wheels, and warm Himalayan hospitality
Hike to the famous viewpoint at Everest View Hotel (3,880 m) for spectacular 360-degree views of Everest
Cross exciting suspension bridges above the rushing Dudh Koshi River
Ideal short Himalayan trek suitable for beginners, families, and travelers with limited time
